description: Incoming trade version is lower than the version already stored for this trade.
remediation: Upstream replayed an old message. Confirm the current version with the source system; no action needed if the stored version is correct.

description: Maturity date is earlier than the trade date, which is economically impossible.
remediation: Booking error. Correct the maturity date and resubmit with an incremented version.

description: Maturity date is earlier than today, so the trade cannot be booked as live.
remediation: Either the trade is a late back-booking (submit through the historical load path) or the maturity date is wrong.

description: One or more mandatory fields are null or absent from the payload.
remediation: Fix the upstream mapping. The rule detail column names the missing field.

description: counterparty_id does not exist in the counterparty reference data.
remediation: Either the counterparty is genuinely new (onboard it, then replay) or the identifier is malformed.

description: notional_currency is not a supported ISO 4217 code.
remediation: Correct the currency code upstream. Watch for lower-case codes and two-letter country codes.

description: Notional amount is zero, negative or absent.
remediation: Direction is carried by buy_sell, never by the sign of the notional. Fix the upstream mapping.

description: The payload could not be interpreted as a trade: unparseable JSON, or a field that failed type coercion.
remediation: Inspect the raw payload in AUDIT.FCT_TRADE_REJECTED. Usually an encoding or serialisation defect upstream.

description: A later arrival carried the same trade_id and version, so this event was replaced.
remediation: Informational. This is business rule 2 (replace same version) operating correctly; no action required.

description: An amendment arrived for a trade that has already been cancelled.
remediation: Cancellation is terminal. To reinstate, book a new trade with a new trade_id.

description: book_id does not exist in the book reference data.
remediation: Onboard the book or correct the identifier. Unmapped books break P&L attribution.

description: Settlement date precedes the trade date.
remediation: Booking error, commonly a timezone or date-format defect upstream.

description: product_type is not a product this platform is authorised to process.
remediation: Route to the correct platform, or extend the supported product list if in scope.

description: Trade date is later than today.
remediation: Almost always a timezone bug. Verify the upstream system is emitting UTC.

description: buy_sell is not one of BUY or SELL.
The counterparty exists but is flagged inactive (defaulted, in administration or offboarded).
remediation: Trading with an inactive counterparty requires credit approval. Escalate rather than resubmitting.

description: A physically-settled product was booked in a non-deliverable currency.
remediation: Rebook as an NDF, or correct the settlement currency to a deliverable one.

description: Notional exceeds the book's configured limit.
remediation: Warning only -- the trade is accepted and flagged. Risk reviews breaches daily.

description: The same UTI was seen on a different trade_id, suggesting a double booking.
remediation: Warning only. Operations reconciles UTIs against the trade repository.
